listing.name: Super Mario 64 — v64recomp / sm64-us (polaco1782)
listing.summary: Experimental project. CastleGrounds screenshot; A complete playthrough has not been confirmed; results from another game do not establish that this one works. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Super Mario 64 Nintendo 64 USA ROM. Check the required size and SHA-1 in games/sm64-us/profile.toml before importing. Keep the original separately. These instructions do not download or run it.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use tools/import_rom.py --profile games/sm64-us/profile.toml to normalize your own .z64, .n64 or .v64 ROM. Build the CMake sm64-us-release target to produce the native sm64-us player. The default keeps the ROM external; an optional build that embeds it must remain private. This is manual setup from source; Portcove-managed download and completed setup or gameplay checks are not offered.

warnings: The project provides a Castle Grounds screenshot. A complete playthrough has not been confirmed, and results from another game do not establish that this one works. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
